title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Gas.cpp and Solver.cpp implement perfect-gas conservative finite-volume, stress/heat and time residual paths; numerical outcomes unavailable.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: GlobalMesh/Partition read CGNS, call METIS and build local owned/ghost mesh; workers drop full preprocessing mesh before iterations.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Solver.cpp computes face spatial fluxes and total transient residual; no original case data remain to verify behavior. Historical contestant commit cf36ac0e77b12262705387d74bc06566a192258b was subsequently found to contain eight packages and original figures; the prior absence statement described the live workspace and is superseded for deliverable evidence. Individual scores remain under review.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Gas.cpp provides Rusanov flux, accurately described in report; no demonstrated entropy-fixed Roe path.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Gas/Solver code includes farfield, slip and no-slip wall treatment; no case artifacts survive to validate wall behavior. Historical contestant commit cf36ac0e77b12262705387d74bc06566a192258b was subsequently found to contain eight packages and original figures; the prior absence statement described the live workspace and is superseded for deliverable evidence. Individual scores remain under review.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Solver.cpp:1169–1176,1369–1378 initializes first order then blends reconstruction after CFL ramp; no surviving run logs establish the exact production mode.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Solver.cpp:269 onward computes Barth-type limiter and positivity fallback, including local first-order fallback; output diagnostics are unavailable.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Solver.cpp:676–704 adds full viscous traction to total force but tangent projection to split, so total can differ from pressure plus viscous components; result data absent. Historical contestant commit cf36ac0e77b12262705387d74bc06566a192258b was subsequently found to contain eight packages and original figures; the prior absence statement described the live workspace and is superseded for deliverable evidence. Individual scores remain under review.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady pseudo-time implicit path and plateau logic exist; missing histories prevent checking the claimed plateaus.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Solver.cpp:1693–1716 tests total per-step strict target and counts degraded early stops as misses; no original Re200 metadata or force history survives to verify claims.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partition, neighbor halos and reductions exist; rank-comparison outputs claimed in report are absent. Historical contestant commit cf36ac0e77b12262705387d74bc06566a192258b was subsequently found to contain eight packages and original figures; the prior absence statement described the live workspace and is superseded for deliverable evidence. Individual scores remain under review.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
